MODEL_FEEDBACK_JSON:
{
  "positive_alignment_reasons": [
    "The heat shrink tubing fits the practical needs of my battery-holder, circuit-board and relay projects because it would help insulate small wire connections.",
    "The digital caliper would help me measure components and mounting dimensions, making it useful across my electronics and hardware projects."
  ],
  "negative_misalignment_reasons": [
    "The heavy battery lugs and sealed automotive wire connectors involve wiring sizes or conditions that my small circuit projects do not establish a need for.",
    "The three filament recommendations assume I own a compatible printer and have something to print; neither follows from my electronics purchases.",
    "The thick acrylic sheet and feeler gauge need specific fabrication or clearance-measuring tasks that I do not currently have."
  ],
  "overgeneralized_signals": [
    "My interest in hands-on electronics seems to have been stretched into an interest in almost any workshop or fabrication supply.",
    "My recent caster purchase correctly suggests relevance, but it does not mean I need another similar set right away."
  ],
  "missing_or_underweighted_signals": [
    "The scale and purpose of my projects matter: breadboards, small battery holders and relay modules point toward small-component work rather than heavy cable installations.",
    "I choose moderately and need a concrete use for an item; broad hobby overlap is not enough, especially when a supply requires equipment I have not shown I own.",
    "A recent durable purchase can mean that need is already covered, even when another version closely matches my interests."
  ],
  "summary_diagnosis": "The recommendations partly understood my small electronics and hardware projects, but stretched that interest into unsupported equipment needs and repeat purchases."
}
